text: This is the brand's catch-all, and its per-input ceilings and its internal_bypass threshold are the QUTEST's, read from that model's manual. They are asserted here for the Hugo, the Dave and the Mojo as well, on evidence that names only one of them - the same over-reach the iFi record writes down. The rate at which the WTA1 stage steps aside is the figure to check first, since it is the one that changes an answer.
